rationales: Cellulose is the main structural component of plant cell walls.
Peptidoglycan is found in bacterial cell walls.
Cholesterol is a lipid, not the main plant cell-wall material.
Chitin is found in fungal cell walls and arthropod exoskeletons.
Nucleoplasm is the fluid inside the nucleus.
Cytosol is the fluid component of the cytoplasm.
Stroma is the fluid-filled interior of a chloroplast.
Cytoplasm is the material inside the cell outside the nucleus.
Chiasmata are not formed during Metaphase I.
Chiasmata form during Prophase I as homologous chromosomes remain joined after crossing over.
Telophase I occurs after homologous chromosomes have separated.
Anaphase I separates homologous chromosomes.
Most enzymes are not carbohydrates.
Most enzymes are proteins.
Enzymes are generally not nucleic acids.
Enzymes are generally not lipids.
Starch is a polysaccharide, not a three-carbon molecule.
Ribose contains five carbon atoms.
Glucose contains six carbon atoms.
Pyruvic acid contains three carbon atoms.
7.02 kcal is not the standard textbook value for ATP hydrolysis.
7.03 kcal is not the standard textbook value for ATP hydrolysis.
7.20 kcal is not the standard textbook value for ATP hydrolysis.
The textbook value is approximately 7.3 kcal per mole of ATP.
Milk contains more than 12% lipids in none of the usual textbook descriptions.
Milk does not typically contain 10% lipids.
0.9% is below the usual lipid content of milk.
Milk is commonly described as containing about 4% lipids.
Pericycle cells lie inside the root, not on its surface as root hairs.
Stomata are pores found mainly on leaves and some stems.
Root hairs are extensions of root epidermal cells.
Cortical cells lie beneath the root epidermis.
Botany is the scientific study of plants.
Zoology is the study of animals.
Anatomy studies the structure of organisms.
Histology studies tissues.
Taxonomy classifies and names organisms.
Sedimentology studies sediments and sedimentary processes.
Genetics studies heredity and variation.
Paleontology is the study of fossils and ancient life.
A hypothesis is a tentative explanation of observations.
An experiment tests a hypothesis or investigates a question.
A deduction is a conclusion drawn from general principles or evidence.
A theory is a well-supported explanation, not merely a tentative one.
The Indus dolphin is an endangered species in Pakistan.
The cow is domesticated and is not generally classified as endangered in Pakistan.
The sparrow is not the endangered species intended here.
The markhor is not currently classified as endangered by the IUCN, though it was historically threatened.
Aristotle did not discover cells.
Robert Brown discovered the cell nucleus.
Robert Hooke observed cork cells and introduced the term “cell.”
Schwann contributed to cell theory but did not discover cells.
The 1974 Nobel Prize was awarded to Albert Claude, Christian de Duve, and George E. Palade, not Rene de Duve.
Camillo Golgi received the Nobel Prize in 1906, not 1974.
Lamarck did not receive the 1974 Nobel Prize.
Aristotle did not receive the 1974 Nobel Prize.
Mitosis produces more than one daughter cell.
One cell divides into two daughter cells during mitosis.
Four daughter cells are typically produced by meiosis, not mitosis.
Mitosis does not produce eight daughter cells.
